rank_universe.base: all complete causal AM/PM bins, not only V12 signals
rank_universe.prior_day_gates: prior completed daily close <=1000 JPY and prior completed daily volume >=10000 shares
rank_universe.timing: rank is computed only after the whole causal bin is complete; AM cutoff 13:00, PM conservative cutoff 16:00
rank_universe.formula: average percentile rank ascending within cohort

cohorts.train_like: V12 event with prior-day gates and all 16 V17 features finite; candidate date<2025-01-01 and fifth-session exit date<2025-01-01; no return values read
cohorts.h1: same representation and gates; candidate date 2025-03-01 through 2025-06-30; no return values read

representation_gate.pass: zero SEVERE features AND at most four MODERATE features
representation_gate.fail: do not open V17 strategy-return metrics
representation_gate.if_pass: commit a separate V17 supervised-evaluation preregistration before any H1 return access
